text: SGO Pro's Pinnacle prices are about 3 to 6 minutes old when read (p90 6 min in the engine's latest ranking). They run 1.3 points off Pinnacle's own line, and that is the closest of the paid feeds. The direct Pinnacle feed (pinnapi, then PinnWire) is under 1 second old, so it stays first for Pinnacle prices. SGO is already the paid backup in the chain: it answers when the direct feed fails or has no game. Using SGO as the main Pinnacle source would make fair odds about 5 minutes staler, so I'm leaving it as is. Sorry for the late answer: your message got caught in the stale-chat bug I'm fixing.
